AI Overview
Your contact form is likely not sending emails because your website's default mail function lacks proper authentication, causing mail providers like Gmail and Yahoo to block or filter the messages as spam. 
Google Workspace Help
 +1
Common Causes & Fixes
Missing Domain Authentication: Major inbox providers reject unauthenticated automated mail. Fix: Install an SMTP plugin like WP Mail SMTP to route your form emails through a verified mailer service. 
WP Mail SMTP
 +2
Disabled PHP Mail: Many modern web hosts disable the default server PHP mail function for security reasons. Fix: Switch your form setup to use SMTP rather than PHP mail. 
Reddit
 +2
Misconfigured "From" Address: Using a generic sender address (like wordpress@example.com) or setting the "From" address to the user's input email triggers anti-spoofing filters. Fix: Change the "From" email in your form settings to a real email address belonging to your actual domain. 
WP Mail SMTP
 +1
Messages Stuck in Spam: The form might be sending successfully, but the notification is hiding in your junk folder. Fix: Check your spam folder and submit a test entry directly from the live site.
